French violinist (born 1945). Born into the musical Pasquier family, he left the Paris Conservatoire at 12 with first prizes in violin and chamber music and made his New York debut two years later. He has been concertmaster of the Orchestre National de France and professor at the Conservatoire National Supérieur de Musique de Paris. With his brother Bruno and the cellist Pidoux he formed the Nouveau Trio Pasquier.
